items.title: Which Streaming Stock Would Hold Up Better in a Recession: Netflix or Walt Disney?
items.summary: Both of these entertainment giants have lost money for their shareholders in 2026.

items.title: Netflix (NFLX) Faces Fresh Creator Pressure As Rivals Offer Exclusive Incentives
items.summary: YouTube reportedly offers major creators new financial incentives to avoid content deals that involve Netflix (NasdaqGS:NFLX), sharpening rivalry between the platforms. The offers focus on exclusive content for YouTube and are aimed at creators who have been in talks with Netflix for non exclusive projects. items.title: Alphabet Stock Ran After Its Ad Machine Had Already Shown Its Work
items.summary: The evidence that search advertising was getting more valuable, not less, sat in Alphabet's own numbers weeks before the price started to move.

items.title: Walt Disney Stock's Next Leg Depends On What It Has Been Building
items.summary: New park and cruise capacity is filling up while guests spend more per visit, and that pairing is the clearest upside case for Walt Disney stock.

items.title: YouTube offers creators millions to avoid Netflix deals
items.summary: The platform has warned that creators who post to Netflix at the same time risk losing marketing support and a cut of brand campaign revenue

items.title: GOOGL Stock Heads For Third Week In Red: YouTube Reportedly Plans Mega Creator Push To Take On Netflix
items.summary: YouTube is offering millions of dollars to popular channels if they upload their videos to the site exclusively for a certain period of time, according to a Bloomberg report.

items.title: Alphabet Stock Surged When Its AI Spending Found Customers
items.summary: Its largest peers all trailed the market over the same year, so the re-rating was about what Alphabet's own spending started to earn rather than about artificial intelligence in general.
